gizmo.title: Mubvunzo wenhamba
gizmo.description: Mubvunzo unopindurwa nenhamba. Mhinduro inhamba yakatarwa kana fomura inoverengwa kubva pazvinoshanduka, uye inoverengwa kana iri mukati memuganhu.

configure.title: Mubvunzo
configure.description: Zvinobvunzwa vadzidzi. Nyora zita rechinoshanduka mumabhuraketi akakombama, se{d}, kuti uratidze kukosha kwacho.

configure.title: Chiyero
configure.description: Chinoratidzwa semavara padivi penzvimbo yemhinduro, semuenzaniso km/h.

configure.title: Mhinduro
configure.description: Nhamba yakarurama. Siya pasina chinhu kana fomura ichiverenga mhinduro.

configure.title: Fomura
configure.description: Inoverenga mhinduro kubva pazvinoshanduka, semuenzaniso d / (t / 60). Inogona kushandisa + - * / ^, mabhuraketi, sqrt() ne abs(). Inoshandiswa panzvimbo pemhinduro kana yaiswa.

configure.title: Zvinoshanduka
configure.description: Nhamba dzinoshandiswa nefomura nemubvunzo. Imwe neimwe inotora kukosha pakati pechidiki nechikuru, nematanho.

advanced.title: Muganhu wekukanganisa
advanced.description: Kuti kure zvakadii nemhinduro chaiyo kuchiri kuverengwa. 0 zvinoreva chaizvo, kana kutenderedzwa kunzvimbo dzedesimari dziri pazasi.

advanced.title: Rudzi rwemuganhu
advanced.description: Chaiyo: plus kana minus muganhu. Muzana: plus kana minus muzana iwoyo wemhinduro chaiyo.

advanced.title: Nzvimbo dzedesimari
advanced.description: Vadzidzi vanokumbirwa kutenderedza kunzvimbo dzakadai, uye mhinduro inoratidzwa yakatenderedzwa kwadziri. Siya pasina chinhu kuti pasave nekutenderedza.

advanced.title: Kuedza
advanced.description: Kangani mudzidzi anogona kutarisa. 0 zvinoreva kusingaperi.

advanced.title: Nhamba itsva pakuedza kwese
advanced.description: Unza kukosha kutsva kwezvinoshanduka pese panoedza mudzidzi zvakare. Mhinduro yavo yekare haizoratidzwi kana vadzoka, chete kana vakarurama.

advanced.title: Inopetwa
advanced.description: Ratidza mubvunzo uyu semutsara unovhurika nekuvhara. Kuvhura imwe kunovhara mimwe mibvunzo inopetwa iri padhuze nayo.

advanced.title: Tanga yakapetwa
advanced.description: Kana ichipetwa, tanga semutsara wakavharwa unoratidza mubvunzo nemamiriro awo chete.

developer.title: Zita rekuyedzwa
developer.description: Zita rekuyedzwa rinoshandiswa pakuzivisa xAPI muhurongwa hwekuongorora.
